picks.what: The town on its cliff seen from the bay, steel engraving in Meyer’s Universum, vol. 8
picks.why: general view of Taganrog along the cliff with its churches, ships in the shallow bay; clean high-resolution scan, preferred over the book-page scan of the same plate (#2); caption trimmed

picks.what: General view of the town toward the bay, postcard
picks.why: the only general view after 1850: rooftops over a wide square out to the bay and port; title text in the sky trimmed; postcard dated only to 1900–1917

gaps: P0–P2: nothing; P5: nothing (the 1917 hits are pre-revolution postcards of single buildings and the stone staircase, dated only ‘before 1917’); P6: only an industrial seaport panorama, a single house and a satellite photo
notes: The 1890 Vorontsov Descent postcard (#7) is a slope and street scene, and its 1890 date field is doubtful for a postcard.
